## Integration Reference (IR)

The named system — "Zendesk", "Jira" — with kind, base URL and an id display hint. Lives on a desk's App Configuration; External Reference embeds a copy of what it needs.

### Non-goals

No credentials, no API config — naming, not connecting. UrlField note: store the bare origin (query strings are dropped by UrlField).
